title: evolvulus paniculatus
intro: Evolvulus paniculatus, commonly known as Blue Daze, is a flowering plant species native to Mexico and Central America. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Evolvulus paniculatus are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce pain and inflammation, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been identified in various studies on the plant's chemical composition.
